learner_operation: Identify the exponential base and RHS, apply log_b(b^c)=c, then undo the signed exponent offset and select the equivalent exact expression.

fixed_features.feature: One exponential b^(x+s)=n with positive small integer b>1,n>0; coefficient of x one.
fixed_features.justification: Tutorial 2794, e-4067 and four source questions teach inversion and at most one additive isolation. Broader neighboring KPs introduce multiplication/approximation/isolation.

fixed_features.feature: Exact logarithmic answer and one radio field with five math choices.
fixed_features.justification: All four source banks use that response contract; fixed choice count preserves workload, not a fixed qualifying label or correct position.

fixed_features.feature: Normal direct banks have no additive offsets; normal shifted banks contain both signs.
fixed_features.justification: Maintains comparable inversion/isolation workload and gives every bank member an eligible inverse equation. Shift sign and selected member are not fixed.

fixed_features.feature: Normal bank contains two distinct bases, several arguments and five distinct numerical choices.
fixed_features.justification: Authors a same-method distractor family; no specific base, argument, multiplicity, rank or option position is privileged. Independent conditional probes test these surface constraints.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Exponential base varies independently; source values 2,3,5,7 are examples.
answer_roles.observed: All integer bases 2..9 observed in independently sampled delivered items.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Positive RHS can be below, equal to, or above the base; RHS is not a fixed source label.
answer_roles.observed: All RHS integers 2..40 observed; same-bank controlled RHS 3 ->5 changes response and explanation.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Zero, positive, negative offsets; undo exponent shift rather than always add/subtract.
answer_roles.observed: Every shift -6..6 observed; controlled fixed b=2,r=3 changes exponent x-1 ->x+1 and answer +1 ->-1.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any bank member may be correct in an eligible inverse equation and any displayed position is permitted.
answer_roles.observed: All five members of each of two fixed banks exercised; fresh templates contain all five key positions and no tested UI position always works.

coverage.case: All roles eligible within a fixed bank
coverage.result: Two banks x five chosen roles checked independently and through native grader; no bank member fixed as key.

coverage.case: Rejection, maximum count and learner selection
coverage.result: Exact replay traces match generator output; bank rejection happens before key selection, semantic deduplication after. At count1000 direct bank saturates sooner, both templates survive. Positive easy weight samples both templates in combined captured/new pool; zero-weight and unconfigured branches exclude new items as specified.

counterfactuals.change: Hold complete five-option direct bank fixed; b=2 RHS 3 ->5.
counterfactuals.expected: Change log_2(3) to log_2(5), with prompt, inversion, final solution and accepted native response following.
counterfactuals.observed: Controlled indexes 0,1; rendered cases 4,5 and native controlled-0/1 agree.
counterfactuals.justification: RHS is answer-bearing under tutorial 2794 inversion.

counterfactuals.change: Hold b=2,RHS=3 and five-option shifted bank fixed; x-1 ->x+1.
counterfactuals.expected: Answer changes log_2(3)+1 ->log_2(3)-1; prior mathematical response becomes wrong.
counterfactuals.observed: Controlled indexes 5,6; both options are present in each bank, and native grade outcomes switch; rendered equations and final solutions switch consistently.
counterfactuals.justification: e-4067 and q-25124/q-100163 require undoing the signed additive shift.

counterfactuals.change: Only reorder displayed choices and change generation seed for fixed b=2,RHS=3,x-1.
counterfactuals.expected: Preserve equation, mathematical correct answer, key UUID, full worked solution and grading.
counterfactuals.observed: Controlled indexes 5,10 preserve all dependencies; native grading accepts same answer. Rendered math is preserved. Delivery deduplication removes the reorder, demonstrating that presentation-only variety is not counted as a new delivered item.
counterfactuals.justification: Source inversion rule is independent of option order; selection key is mathematical, not positional.

fresh learner inventory pool and within-easy weighted selection
delivery.result: 320/320 independent items and 5/5 runner records retained at captured basis4974. Fresh remains 160 direct /160 shifted; runner remains 3 direct /2 shifted. Controlled irrelevant reorder alone removed. New items have uniform within-easy selection when easy weight is positive; 2022 new generated draws among 2048 combined-pool simulations retain both cases, with conditional shortcut probes recorded. Selection fallback cases correctly do not claim generated-item delivery.

limitations: Finite tests support the stated shortcut claims, not absence of all conceivable shortcuts.
Inventory is captured at basis4974; later publication can alter deduplication and relative selection shares.

Live policy weights, learner history, assigned numeric IDs and task seeds are not supplied. Selection is examined parametrically with faithful rules and synthetic new IDs; exact live draws are not claimed.

Unconfigured policy selects minimum candidate ID; easy-zero policy uses unrated fallback, so generated easy records are not reached under those policy branches. Those are selector semantics rather than a generator defect.
No unsupported original question family was omitted; canonical example has no captured answer bank.
Screenshot inspection used desktop completed-answer UI; responsive/mobile layouts are outside this review.
